versions.subject: Merge PR #5444 from @CheraghiMilad - Discovery System Info via Sysinfo Syscall
versions.detection:
selection:
    type: 'SYSCALL'
    syscall: 'sysinfo'
filter_optional_splunk:
    exe|endswith: '/bin/splunkd'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_optional_*
